Exercise: Lateral Cone Hops

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- lateral_jumping

Primary Muscles:

- adductors

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings
- quadriceps

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- enhance_lateral_stability_and_coordination
- improve_explosive_power

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Lateral Cone Hops, id: Single_Leg_Lateral_Cone_Hops

Substitution Options:

- name: Lateral Bound, id: Lateral_Bound

Instructions:

- Position a number of cones in a row several feet apart.
- Stand next to the end of the cones, facing 90 degrees to the direction of travel. This will be your starting position.
- Begin the jump by dipping with the knees to initiate a stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to push off the ground, jumping up and sideways over the cone.
- Use your legs to absorb impact upon landing, and rebound into the next jump, continuing down the row of cones.
